scoring.formula: composite = 60% x value_score + 40% x accessibility_score (each 0-100). No annual-fee-payback lens in individual scores — that math lives in the separate 'Minimum Path to Break Even' calculator below.
scoring.occasion_note: Occasion Fit (Date Night, Business, Free Treat) is a separate ranking scoped to bookable Dining venues only — it blends value_score (50%) with venue-tier fit for the occasion (50%).

value_types.label: Discount
value_types.definition: You spend money and get less than full price. Scored on discount depth vs. minimum spend to unlock.

value_types.label: Free
value_types.definition: Genuinely complimentary — may need enrollment or booking. Scored on estimated $ value vs. how much friction (enrollment/booking/caps) stands between you and it.

value_types.label: Credit
value_types.definition: A pooled annual $ credit, may need a minimum spend to activate. Scored on $ value vs. spend required to activate.

value_types.label: Access
value_types.definition: An always-on entitlement (lounge, insurance, concierge, status, protections) that isn't 'redeemed' per use — shown as a feature card with no score, since forcing a number onto insurance coverage or lounge access is false precision.

occasions.desc: Romantic, 2-for-1 sweet spot — best discounts almost everywhere are for pairs.

occasions.label: Business Dinner
occasions.desc: Polished, quiet fine-dining suited to entertaining a client — not bargain-hunting.

occasions.label: Free Treat
occasions.desc: Zero minimum spend — a genuinely complimentary dining experience or credit.

caveats: Average bill-per-pax figures are ESTIMATES based on cuisine/venue tier, used only to make deals comparable — Amex and most restaurants do not publish menu prices.
Annual-use caps for the Minimum Path to Break Even are realistic assumptions, not guarantees — your actual usage will vary.
Scores reflect the BEST-CASE published discount tier (typically dining as a pair).

Promos, restaurant rosters, and T&Cs change frequently and are refreshed roughly every two weeks — always reconfirm blackout dates and current terms directly with Amex or the venue before relying on it.
